title: More Pressure On Putin
summary:
G7 countries are discussing significant additional sanctions
One month ago, there was cautious optimism about a possible resolution to the conflict in Ukraine. President Putin and President Trump met in Alaska on August 15, and while the summit did not produce any formal agreements or jointly signed declarations, both leaders described the meeting as productive. However, there has been no progress since.
